learning_outcomes.text: To solve thermodynamic problems of chemical processes
Ability to calculate the thermodynamic properties of mixtures and pure substances
Ability to determine the phase compositions in mixtures that show/do not show ideal behavior
To be able to calculate the changes in the thermodynamic properties of a fluid flowing in different systems.
